credibility.line: None of these promises can be checked against reported numbers yet — no score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue growth accelerated from 10.4% in Dec 2025 to 29.8% YoY in Sep 2026.
PAT fell -24.6% YoY in Jun 2026 despite management claiming group EBITDA rose 10%.
EBITDA margins weakened from 18% in Dec 2024 to 15% in Mar and Jun 2026.

bull: Quarterly revenue growth accelerated to 29.8% YoY reaching ₹330,601 crore in Sep 2026.
5-year operating cash conversion is strong at 190% of net profit.
Free cash flow expanded to ₹70,023 crore in FY2026 from ₹41,079 crore in FY2025.
bear: PAT reported negative YoY growth of -8.9% in Mar 2026 and -24.6% in Jun 2026.
EBITDA margin dropped to 15% during Mar 2026 and Jun 2026 quarters.
Total borrowings rose to ₹405,322 crore at Sep 2026 from ₹374,313 crore in Mar 2025.
watch: Execution on 20-GW solar PV and 40-GWh battery capacity targets.
Retail segment EBITDA trajectory toward 2-year doubling target.
Sustainability of Q2 FY27 PAT recovery of 33.8% YoY.
